Hotel stay activities
Oct 2026 • Family
We stayed at Allegro hotel for 4 nights Oct 2026 with a large family group. Staff have been very friendly and so helpful in organising acivities for us. The lantern making at the hotel was a great activity for everyone. The buffet breakfast is outstanding and the rooms are very clean and well appointed with connecting family rooms. Pool is great for families. Close to old town centre with electric buggies available if you dont want to walk (we are travelling with elderly and toddler). Bike riding to the vegetable farm is a great activity with buffalo rides and farmer interaction. Electric buggy for elderly. We will be back!! Outstanding hotel and staff!
Read more

Allegro Management Team
Dear D1948XDelenad,

Greetings from Melody Fine Dining Restaurant!

Thank you very much for sharing such a wonderful review of your four-night stay at Allegro Hoi An.

We are delighted to know that you and your family had such an enjoyable and memorable experience with us. It is especially heartwarming to hear that our team was friendly and helpful in arranging activities for your large family group.

We are pleased that you enjoyed our lantern-making experience and that it was a fun activity for everyone. We are also glad to hear that you enjoyed our outstanding buffet breakfast, clean and well-appointed rooms, connecting family rooms, and family-friendly swimming pool.

It is wonderful to know that our location close to Hoi An Ancient Town, along with the electric buggy service, made it more convenient for your family, especially when traveling with elderly family members and a toddler.

We are also happy that you enjoyed the bicycle trip to the vegetable farm, including the buffalo ride and the opportunity to interact with local farmers. We truly hope these experiences added special memories to your family holiday in Hoi An.

Thank you once again for your kind words and for recommending Allegro Hoi An. We are absolutely delighted to hear that you will be back, and we look forward to welcoming you and your family again for another outstanding stay.
